rationale: P characterises the braking behaviour directly required to evaluate SG-3, with obstacle absence grounded in H-3's hazardous event. Its declared operational scope matches H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, rather than an ancillary control mechanism. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing requirements.
determining_elements: "Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle" identifies the system behaviour addressed by the target "Prevent unintended braking."
"Whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present in front of the vehicle" is supported by H-3's description of sudden stopping without an obstacle ahead.
The scope—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead—matches H-3's operational situation.
